brief.text: Create a collectible Art Deco radio with a rounded walnut cabinet, brass trim, a geometric speaker grille, an inset tuning dial and animated controls.

revisions.title: Initial design
revisions.description: First retained radio. Solid bezel faces obscured the dial and grille, and several decorative bars extended beyond the cabinet.

revisions.title: Frame and cabinet repair
revisions.description: Opened the bezel frames, contained the grille bars and fitted the rear panels to the stepped cabinet.

revisions.title: Dial and grille revision
revisions.description: Moved the dial and grille layers in front of the cabinet surface and added fluting to the controls and shoulders.

revisions.title: Final Gemini authoring revision
revisions.description: Added woven grille bars, detailed feet and finer tuning-knob flutes. The tuning scale uses marks rather than numeric labels.

revisions.title: Maintainer rear-panel fit and finish
revisions.description: Codex maintainer agent resized the three rear panels to stay inside the flat cabinet faces, matched their walnut material, and repositioned the louvers and power grommet. Actual front and rear GPU views inspected. Original dial and control animation retained.

revisions.title: Flush faces fixed
revisions.description: Maintainer revision by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12): 3 part edits that separate faces lying on one plane, which flickered in any renderer. Materials, names, hierarchy and animation are unchanged.
